cells.gaps: No share or count of primary clinics entering their own reports is held, and no coverage fact is dated after 2021. The facts disagree on where data is keyed: the ministry's 2021 plan (SEN-025, newest) runs DHIS2 from the districts up, while SEN-057 (2021) and SEN-020 (2018, four districts) describe entry at health posts. The regressing fact inside the twelve months (SEN-035) carries its document's date, not an event's, and the finance in SEN-036 was not yet approved.
cells.note: DHIS2 is national and used at every tier, with the newest dated fact placing entry at the district. Stage 4 needs more than half of primary clinics entering their own reports on a share or a count with a denominator, and none is published.

cells.gaps: The 1% is of the 102 district health centres only, with health posts outside the denominator; hospital use is established at one named regional hospital, and the one health post is a pilot site reported in April 2025. Retrieval of the record at another facility is not stated, so `shared` is not held. Inside the twelve months SEN-012 (advancing, 31 October 2025) and SEN-034 (the 51-centre pilot not started at December 2025) disagree; the newer stands and no flag is set. No fact says whether that pilot began in 2026.
cells.note: The record runs at pilot facilities: one regional hospital, about one health centre in 102 and one health post. Stage 3 needs most T1 and T2 hospitals or primary clinics across some districts, and neither is evidenced.
